name: House Atreides
status: Great House (Landsraad) → Imperial House under Paul and Leto II
colours_visual: Green and black (ORIGINAL references to 'green and black Atreides'); weathered naval aesthetic, stone and sea [VERIFY colour pairing in text]
origin: Claims descent from the House of Atreus (ORIGINAL: Paul's ancestry is linked to Agamemnon in Dune). EU: Vorian Atreides.
key_members: Leto I, Paul, Alia, Leto II, Ghanima; later Siona, Moneo, Miles Teg, Odrade (bloodline)
power_base: Popularity in the Landsraad; 'the Atreides form' of loyal, highly trained troops
military: Small but elite army rivalling Sardaukar (the Emperor's fear); Fremen after 10191
economy: Pundi rice (Caladan); later spice monopoly via Arrakis
culture: Honour, loyalty, justice; father-to-son duty; bullfighting heritage (EU detail) [VERIFY]
allies: Fremen; Gurney's smugglers; (EU) House Vernius, Ecaz

name: House Harkonnen
status: Great House; Siridar-Barons; stewards of Arrakis before 10191
seat: Harko City / Barony on Giedi Prime
colours_visual: Blue and black; industrial, oily, brutal geometry [Films: monochrome black-sun aesthetic = FILM ADAPTATION]
origin: Ancient feud with Atreides; EU: Abulurd branded coward after Corrin (88 BG)
key_members: Baron Vladimir, Feyd-Rautha, Glossu Rabban, Piter de Vries (servant); EU/TV: Valya & Tula, Xavier, Abulurd
power_base: CHOAM directorship wealth; spice profits from Arrakis; cruelty as policy
military: Harkonnen troops plus covert Sardaukar support in 10191
economy: Spice profits; Giedi Prime industry; whale fur (Lankiveil, EU detail)
culture: Cruelty, decadence, slavery, gladiatorial games, poisons
fate: Destroyed as a power after Paul's victory; secret blood survives in Jessica → Paul → all Atreides
continuity_notes: Black-sun and albino Giedi Prime are Part Two inventions. The secret Harkonnen-Atreides blood is ORIGINAL.
